What was the rolling 12-month average government cost per person for Anti-infectives medicines in Ballarat in Jan 2023 (AUD)?

Source: Lower Cedar Institute of Health and Welfare (https://viz.lowercedarhealthwelfare.example/data/pbs-dashboard?group=Anti-infectives&area=Ballarat&month=Jan%202023).

arguments.code:
import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('/workspace/te0322/data/pbs-dashboard.csv')

# Filter data for Ballarat, Anti-infectives, and Jan 2023
ballarat_data = data[(data['area'] == 'Ballarat') & (data['medicines'] == 'Anti-infectives') & (data['month'] == 'Jan 2023')]

# Calculate rolling 12-month average
ballarat_data['rolling_avg'] = ballarat_data['cost_per_person'].rolling(window=12).mean()

# Select the average cost per person
average_cost = ballarat_data['rolling_avg'].iloc[-1]

print(f'Rolling 12-month average cost per person: {average_cost:.2f} AUD')
